senses.gloss: pr. n. f.Sh’mirah, wife of Nebuchadnezzar.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite>, end <he>רב הונא אמר ש׳ שמה</he> Rab H. says, her name was Sh’mirah; R. A. says, <he>שְׁמִירָמוֹת שמה</he> her name was Sh’miramoth; the Rabbis say <he>שְׁמִירַעַם שמה</he> her name was Sh’miraʿam.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 309:2">Yalk. Jer. 309</cite> <he>עד שהגיעו לש׳ אשתו וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="U01484"><he>שְׁמִירַת</he></cite>) until they came to Sh., the wife &c.; Tanḥ.
